title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: Nine copies of a certain pamphlet cost less than \(\$10.00\) while ten copies of the same pamphlet (at the same price) cost more than \(\$11.00.\) How much does one copy of this pamphlet cost?

solutions.text:
From \(9p \lt 10\) we get \(p \lt 1.111\ldots,\) and from \(10p \gt 11\) we get \(p \gt 1.10.\)

The only price in whole cents between \(\$1.10\) and \(\$1.111\ldots\) is \(\$1.11.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: Let the price be \(p;\) then \(9p \lt 10\) and \(10p \gt 11\)
Combine into \(1.10 \lt p \lt 1.111\ldots\) and find the price in whole cents
